newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, JUNE 3 - THURSDAY, JUNE 12.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, JUNE 3 - THURSDAY, JUNE 12.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg). TUESDAY, JUNE 3
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT)

- Opinion C-122/95 Germany v/ Council: external relations. Annulment of the act approving in the name of the Community the agreement concluded between the EC and Costa Rica, Columbia, Nicaragua and Venezuela regarding bananas. Article 1 paragraph 1, first line, of Council decision 94/800 of December 22, 1994, on the conclusion in the name of the EC as it concerns matters within its competence in agreements in the Uruguay Round multilateral negotiations. Annex I A of the accord instituting the WTO - Point 1 of Marrakesh protocol, article 4, paragraph 1 of the agricultural agreement.

- (1100/0900 GMT)Oral procedure C-44/96 Mannesmann Anlagenbau: company law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1 (b) and 6, paragraph 4 of Council directive 93/37/EEC of June 14, 1993, on coordination procedures for public procurement supply contracts. Enterprise benefiting from special and exclusive rights. Enterprise also exercising a commercial activity. Notion of adjudicating power. Notion of public procurement supply contracts. State printer. Subsidiary devoted to activities in the private sector. Interpretation of article 7, paragraph 1 of Council regulation 2081/93 of July 20, 1993, amending Council regulation 2052/88 on the tasks of the structural funds and their effectiveness and on coordination of their activities between themselves and with the operations of the European Investment Bank and the other existing financial institutions.
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 4
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (enlarged)(0930/0830 GMT)

- Oral procedure joined cases C-T-213/95, T-18/96 SCK and FNK v/ Commission: company law. Appeal for damages. Non contractual responsibility of the commission following from its alleged breach of article 6 of the Convention on Human Rights and the general principles of law during an application procedure of EC treaty article 85, paragraph 1 on the mobile crane market.
THURSDAY, JUNE 5
FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT)

- Opinion C-362/95 P Blackspur DIY v/ Council and Commission: trade policy. Appeal against court judgment (first chamber enlarged), rendered September 18, 1995, in case T-168/94, Blackspur DIY v/ Council and Commission. Rejection of recourse introduced on the basis of EC treaty articles 178 and 215, paragraph 2. Compensation for damages incurred following the imposition of definitive anti-dumping duty on brush imports from China.
SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT)

- Judgment C-105/94 Celestini: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article EC treaty articles 30 and 36. Interpretation of article 74, paragraph 2(c) of Council regulation 822/87 of March 16, 1987, on the common organisation of the market in wine and of Commission regulation 2676/90 of September 17, 1990, determining community methods for the analysis of wines. Isotopic search for oxygen.
THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT)

- Judgment joined cases C-64/96, C-65/96 Uecker: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 48, paragraph 2 of the EC treaty and of articles 7, paragraph 4 and 11 of Council regulation 1612/68, of October 15, 1968, on freedom of movement for workers within the community. Right of family members to engage in salaried activity. Spouse a citizen of a non-EU state. Conditions of employment. Equal treatment. Limitation of work contracts for foreign language assistants.

FOURTH CHAMBER (1000/0800 GMT) oral procedure C-237/96 Amelynck: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Council regulation 222/77 of December 13, 1976, on community transit and of Commission regulation 223/77 of December 22, 1976, on application procedures as well as simplifying measures for community transit arrangements insofar as said regulation establishes a rule according to which proof of the community nature of goods must figure, except where specifically provided for, by transit document T2 or T2L. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 9 and 10 and of articles 37, paragraph 2 and 39, paragraph 2 of Council regulation 222/77.

- Oral procedure C-270/96 Laboratories Sarget: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article of Council regulation 1010/86 of March 25, 1986, laying down general rules for the production refund on certain sugar products used in the chemical industry. Interpretation of chapters 21 and 30 of the Common Customs and Excise Tariff. Products "SARGENORI", "SARVIT", "LYSIVIT" and "DYNAMISAN".
FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT)

- Judgment C-2/95 SDC: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. interpretation of article 13, part B(d), points 3 to 5 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Exemption of operations effected by a banking group and consisting in electronic payments for member companies and others. Consultative function vis-a-vis members concerning the purchase and sale of funds, and management of deposits. The taxable individual being the one who grants the credits.

- Judgment C-107/96 Commission v/ Spain: environment and consumers. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 91/156/EEC of March 18, 1991, amending Council directive 75/442 on waste.

- Judgment C-223/96 Commission v/ France: environment and consumers. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 91/156/EEC of March 18, 1991, amending Council directive 75/442/EEC on waste.

- Opinion joined cases C-31/96, C-32/96, C-33/96 Naranjo Arjona: free movement of persons-Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 47, paragraph l(e) and (g) of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 1248/93 of April 30, 1992. Calculation of theoretical old age pension by the institution of a member state whose law provides that the calculation be made on an mean contribution basis. Reuter European Court of Justice Diary (page 2/2)

- Oral procedure C-284/96 Tabouillot: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 95 of the EC treaty. Differentiated tax system for motorised vehicles. Tax as a function of fiscal power. Methods of determining fiscal power unfavourable to imported cars.

- (1015/0815 GMT) Oral procedure C-346/95 Blasi: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 13(B.b) of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Exemption of rent on real estate. Rental of furnished rooms with minimum service for a period of 6 months or more.

- (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-116/96 Reisebuero Binder: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 9, paragraph 2(b) of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Tax basis. Cross-border transport of persons. Criteria for sharing out the compensation received on the basis of the distance travelled.
SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT)

- Judgment C-285 Kol: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 6, paragraph 1 and 14, paragraph 1 of the EU/Turkey Association Council directive 1/80. Worker - right of stay - regular employment - stay permit obtained on the basis of deliberately false declarations constituting an infraction. Expulsion - general measures of prevention.

- Judgment C-398/95 Syndesmos ton en Elladi Touristikon: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 59 and 60. National regulation that the link between tourist guides and travel agencies is covered by the right to work.

- Judgment C-41/96 SYD-Consult: competition. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 85 and Commission regulation 123/85 of December 12, 1984, on the application of article 85, paragraph 3 of the EC treaty to categories of distribution, sales and after sales service agreements on automobiles. National law on unfair competition requiring a closed system so that system members can obtain injunctions prohibiting third parties from distributing the products in question. Distinction between distribution systems closed in theory and those closed both in theory and in practice.

- Judgment C-56/96 VT4: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 2 of Council directive 89/552/EEC of October 3, 1989, on the coordination of member states' laws, regulations and administrative provisions on the exercise of televised radio broadcasting. Scope of application "ratione personae" - programme specifically aimed at the public of a member state other than the one in which it is formally based.

- Opinion C-191/95 Commission v/ Germany: company law. Non respect. Failure to have provided adequate sanctions against companies that abstain from publishing their annual accounts according to Council directives 68/151/EEC: first council directive of March 9, 1968, on coordination of safeguards which, for the protection of the interests of members and others, are required by member states of companies within the meaning of the second paragraph of EC treaty article 58, with a view to making such safeguards equivalent throughout the community, and 7B/660/EEC: fourth Council directive of July 15, 1978, based on article 54, paragraph 3(g) of the EC treaty on the annual accounts of certain forms of company.

- (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-246/96 Magorrian: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Equal pay between male and female workers. Exclusion of part time workers from the benefits of certain advantages as regards old age pension. Exclusion affecting principally female workers. Date from which the retroactive granting of the above-mentioned advantages must be calculated.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT)

- Oral procedure T-218/95 Le Canne v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of Commission decision contained in a note of October 27, 1995, reducing aid for the modernisation and improvement of a fish farm in Rosolina (costa dell'Alto Adriatico), granted in the framework of Council regulation 4028/86 of December 18, 1986, on community actions for the improvement and adaptation of structures in the fish and aquaculture sector.
FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT)

- Oral procedure joined cases T-121/91, T-151/96 Mutual Aid Administration Services Commission: agriculture. Annulment of commission decisions on sums to be paid by the claimant to Georgian authorities within the framework of an adjudication on expenses for the provision of a lot of rye flour destined for Armenia and Georgia, attributed to it in application of Commission regulation 2781/95 of December 1, 1995, on transport for the free provision of rye flour to Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan and Tadzhikistan.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, JUNE 10-12.
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT)
- Opinion C-391/95 Van Uden: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions.
- Oral procedure C-265/95 Commission v/ France: free movement of goods.
- (1100/0900 GMT) Oral procedure C-118/96 Safir: free movement of persons.
THURSDAY, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT)
- Opinion C-261/96 Conserchimica: free movement of goods.
- Opinion C-307/96 Baldone: free movement of persons.
SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT)
- Opinion C-291/96 Grado: free movement of persons.
FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT)
- Judgment C-151/96 Commission v/ Ireland: free movement of persons.
- Opinion C-27/96 Danisco Sugar: membership of new states.
- Oral procedure C-113/96 Gomez Rodriguez: free movement of persons.
- (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-97/96 Daihatsu Deutschland: company law.
SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT)
- Judgment C-110/95 Yamanouchi Pharmaceutical: approximation of legislation.
- Judgment C-266/95 Merino Garcia: free movement of persons.
- Judgment C-138/96 Commission v/ Germany: agriculture.
- Oral procedure joined cases C-232/95, C-233/95 Commission v/ Greece: environment and consumers.
- (1030/0830 GMT) Oral procedure C-68/96 Grundig Italiana: taxation.
- (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-66/96 Hoj Pedersen: social policy.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT)
- Oral procedure T-71/96 Berlingieri Vinzek v/ Commission: status of officials.
SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged)(0930/0730 GMT)
- Judgment T-504/93 Tierce Ladbroke v/ Commission: competition.
